page.layout: One printed page, 236, a single column of text with a run-in heading in italic at the start of the second paragraph. A section number "34" stands in the left margin beside that paragraph. At the far right edge of the scan a strip of the facing printed page shows marginal text in narrow columns, but it is cropped and mostly unreadable, so it is not transcribed. Catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: traditionibus, turbare conentur, interdum etiam nonnullis impo-nant, tamen exstiterunt hactenus viri pii, qui verbis & factis initum, consensum sancte semper tenen-dum omnibus summo studio com-mendent.

34In formula consensus evangelicorum Sendomiriae in Polonia initi an. 1570. hæc leguntur. Convenimus, ut quemadmodum illi (vid. Augusta-nam confessionem profitentes) nos, (qui subscripserunt confessioni Helveticarum ecclesiarum) sic etiam nos illarum ecclesias eodem christiano amore prosequamur, & orthodoxas fateamur: extremumq; vale dicamus & altum silentium imponamus omnibus rixis, distractionibus, dissidiis, quibus euangelii cursus, non sine maxima multorum piorum offensione, impeditus est: & unde adversariis nostris no levis calumniandi & verae christianae religioni nostrae contradicendi occasio fuit subministrata: quin potius

page.notes: The facing printed page at the right edge is cropped; its text is not legible enough to transcribe. Small faint marks at the foot of the left page, below the last line, are illegible and were left out. The number "34" beside the paragraph is taken as a marginal section number. The run-in italic heading is read as printed, with "1570." in roman type.
